name: python
description: Tight verify loop for Python repos — uv (never bare pip/python) + ruff format and lint with a broad select set + basedpyright on recommended/all with every diagnostic an error + pytest, all as one gate (mise run check), zero violations, noqa requires rule code and documented reason. Use whenever editing Python code, before committing Python work, when the ruff/basedpyright/pytest gate is red, or when setting up tooling for a new Python project.
author: jtrv
